<div class="card-body">
'''Darth Vader''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ダース・ベイダー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">戦闘の際、各戦闘運命数を+1できる（合計に+1ではなく、1回引くごとに+1できる）。彼が操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力+3となる。「ベイダー専用タイ・ファイター」に乗っているなら、戦闘力+4、回避値+3となる。耐：損耗&lt;5。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Darth-Vader-Encyclopedia32-original.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">シスの暗黒卿。皇帝の僕。サイバネティック生命維持装置を内蔵した装甲服に身を包む。オビ=ワン・ケノービの弟子であった。銀河一のパイロットであり、狡猾な戦士でもある。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Darth Vader

'''Card text:''' During battle, may add 1 to each battle destiny (not 1 to the total, but 1 for each draw). A starship he pilots gets power +3. If aboard Vader's Custom TIE, it gets power +4 and maneuver +3. Immune to attrition &lt;5.

'''Lore:''' Dark Lord of the Sith. Servant of the Emperor. Wears armored clothing with built-in cybernetic life-support equipment. Was a pupil of Obi-Wan Kenobi. The galaxy's foremost pilot and also a cunning warrior.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Darth Vader]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
